Compendium — Album

S8 · drawn 2026-08-16 to the rulings · six ratified viewports · logical pixels · DENSITY_TOKENS · unpainted

DRAWN TO CLOSED RULINGS, FOR APPROVAL. Every frame here renders a decision that is already made: CMP-1..22 are RESOLVED, rulings [CMP-S1]–[CMP-S20] (owner walk, 2026-08-15). Nothing below is a hypothesis or an option. UBS-7 lifts on approval of this album, per [DSX-S29] — not on the walk having closed.

The compendium is a closed candidate list over the active pack's content ([CMP-S1]) rendered over the semantic reference entries the B3-REFERENCE-MODEL plan specifies. It has no search field, it is campaign-scoped and pack-themed ([CMP-S18]), and its discovery state belongs to the run, not the save ([CMP-S6]).

1 · The ratified composition, across all six viewports

[CMP-S3]: two regions, categories as the facet row — the ratified record-screen archetype, no new composition. Expanded shows list and entry simultaneously; Compact and Medium portrait collapse to the sequential chain in §2. There is no search field and no pack line in the app bar ([CMP-S1], CMP-12).

2 · The Compact chain

Categories → entries → entry. [CMP-S1]: the categories step is the discovery mechanism — enumerable by construction, with no text field anywhere in the chain.

3 · The entry — three regions, and the entries that have only two

[CSA-15] makes the entry three regions: rules, notes, and a visual region fed by art_asset facts. [CMP-S5] places it in the header and makes it absent entirely where the entry has no art — which is most entries. [CSA-26] requires native, unswapped colours plus the swap enumeration here; More Info shows the context-resolved variant instead, and that difference is ruled, not accidental.

4 · History — the affordance nothing else in the programme has

[CMP-S9]: a true back/forward stack over both chain steps and link jumps, because following a related link is a sideways jump rather than a step down the chain. [CMP-S10]: back always; forward only where the size class has room, and never as the only path to anything. [CMP-S17]: the stack is session-scoped and does not survive leaving.

5 · Discovery — hidden entries, and the links that point at them

[CMP-S2]: undiscovered entries are hidden, not shown-disabled-with-a-reason — a named exception to the EPUX-02/RPD-15 availability vocabulary, because here the reason string is the spoiler. [CMP-S12]: a related link pointing at a hidden entry is omitted entirely. Both are presentation filters over a complete graph — the semantic document always contains everything ([CMP-S13]).

6 · Deep-link arrival, and the return

[CMP-S14]: “Open Reference” always navigates — one behaviour from every caller, and the entry always gets full room. The return restores the caller's state, not merely its screen: selection, cursor, open panel and scroll. The caller is history entry zero (CMP-9), so the stack handles the return with no special case.

7 · The provenance setting

[CMP-S16]: a player setting with a per-campaign author default, governing the entire in-game compendium, and permitted to go to zero. This is the view-time profile the model previously lacked — none/summary/full are export parameters. Zeroing it is safe because the compendium is not the attribution channel: [CRD-3]'s always-reachable Credits screen is, which is exactly the separate non-suppressible channel [CSA-13] was ruled to get.

8 · Facet overflow

[CMP-S11]: categories scroll horizontally, with the active one always scrolled into view — the behaviour facets already have, inherited rather than invented, since [CMP-S3] made categories facets. Eight categories exceed what UUI-19 fitted in a 524 px landscape rect, so overflow is certain.

9 · Empty states

Two exist. A third — the no-pack state — does not exist at all, and that is [CMP-S18]: the compendium is campaign-scoped, so it cannot be reached without an active pack, and the main menu gains no entry for it.

What this album deliberately does not draw

  • A no-pack empty state. [CMP-S18] makes the compendium campaign-scoped; it cannot be reached without an active pack, so the state does not exist. The main menu gains no compendium entry either.
  • A search field, anywhere. [CMP-S1]. The static HTML export keeps its full-text search — a browser has a keyboard — but that is not this surface.
  • A pack/version line in the app bar. CMP-12 ruled it not shown; pack identity appears in the entry under the [CMP-S16] setting.
  • An in-place deep-link panel. [CMP-S14] ruled always-navigate; the rejected panel died on measured geometry, recorded in §6.
